proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness is a property that inheres in an agent or a set of agents — it characterises how connected an agent is within a relational or institutional network. As a measurable, bearer-specific property it fits BFO Quality (BFO_0000019) best. It is not a disposition (no triggering stimulus pattern is implied by the term alone) and not a role (it is not externally conferred by a social function). It parallels existing working classes such as RelationalCoherence and StructurallyGroundedIdentity, both typed as Quality.

relations.rationale: Asserts AgentConnectedness as a subclass of BFO Quality, consistent with its typing above.

open_questions: Should 'agent connectedness' be understood as a quality of an individual agent (how integrated that agent is into a network) or as a quality of the network/system as a whole? The answer may shift the bearer class and possibly the BFO type.
Is 'agent connectedness' intended as a purely structural/topological property (suggesting Quality) or does it imply a capacity or potential to connect (which would favour Disposition, BFO_0000016)?
Is this concept meant to specialise an existing working class such as RelationalCoherence or NetworkNode, or is it genuinely orthogonal to those?
proposal.rationale_summary: The phrase 'agent connectedness' most naturally denotes a specifically dependent continuant that measures or characterises the degree to which an agent is integrated into a relational or institutional network. BFO Quality (BFO_0000019) is the best fit because qualities are properties that inhere in a single bearer and are directly measurable or assessable — connectedness in graph-theoretic and social-ontological senses is paradigmatically such a property. It is typed as a class (common noun denoting a kind) rather than an individual. The closest existing working classes (RelationalCoherence, StructurallyGroundedIdentity, NetworkNode) are related but distinct in meaning, so a new class is minted. Three open questions are raised because the precise bearer, the structural-vs-dispositional reading, and the relationship to sibling classes all affect the final typing decision.
